_comment: Rows for /pokemon-stocking-stuffers-under-25 (BET-20261113-1, Deal Hunter, Goal League S1). Every price is our dated SOLD mark: a median of the completed eBay sales PriceCharting lists for that exact product, 30 days to the read, eBay rows only, titles filtered (own set named and no other; out: weighed/'heavy'/gram-marked packs, lots, multiples, blisters or tins filed on a pack page, other languages, damaged, opened, graded). n >= 3 or the row is not printed. 'launch' rows are a retailer launch price with its source, labelled, never a sale. 'link' rows point to another page's prices and print none here. eBay is a search link only, never a mark. Edit here, then run: node tools/build-stocking-stuffers.mjs. Never hand-edit the STUFF block.
